🏆 Devices sold *
List each device sold, its Gross Value (rep-entered sale price for that device, before any bundled add-ons), and the payment type the buyer is using for that device (Cash / Internal / 3rd-party / Partnered 3P; pick TBD if undecided — Ops can update later in the Booking Queue). Add-ons recorded below deduct from gross to compute the device's Net Value, which is what counts toward revenue. Per-device Net is frozen for the rep at close; Ops can adjust in the Booking Queue before booking.
Attribution
Pick the rep who originally generated this opportunity and the rep who closed it. Both lists are scoped to your team — the RM is intentionally excluded since they don't share commission with reps.

Mandatory: if any of these were bundled into the deal, record them here. Leave blank if not applicable.

💳 CC Deposit (optional)
Run a credit-card deposit at closing. Posts as a deposit payment on the first device line and flows through the existing booking-gate + refund logic. Leave blank if no deposit at close.
